title: Transportation of Workers on Back of Lorries
what_it_is: Transportation of Workers on Back of Lorries

sections.label: School bus seat belt retrofit
sections.summary: After an eight-year-old died in 2008, seat belts were retrofitted in all school buses with $35 million set aside to help bus companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For our school children, we moved decisively to retrofit seat belts in all school buses when an eight-year-old died in 2008 after being flung out of his school bus in a traffic accident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We set aside $35 million to help bus companies make our school buses safer.

sections.label: SAF tonner safety features
sections.summary: Since 2011 all SAF tonners have lap belts for rear passengers, plus side boards, railings, canopies, safety straps, seating limits and speed limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For our soldiers, the SAF equipped all SAF tonners with safety lap belts for rear passengers since 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Other safety features on our SAF tonners now include protective side boards, railings, canopies, rear safety straps, seating capacity limits and vehicular speed limits.

sections.label: Lorry passenger casualty trend
sections.summary: Amy Khor said in Parliament in May 2021 that injuries and deaths of persons on board lorries fell over the last decade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Amy Khor shared in Parliament in May 2021 that the number of persons on board lorries who were injured or killed in road accidents has been on a downward trend over the last decade.

sections.label: Iswaran on lorry rear passengers
sections.summary: Iswaran said in May 2022 that lorry suppliers viewed carrying passengers on rear decks as not ideal from a road safety perspective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Minister Iswaran said in May 2022 that the lorry suppliers’ view was that it is not ideal for lorries to carry passengers in their rear decks from a road safety perspective.

sections.label: Ban workers on lorry decks
sections.summary: The long-term solution must be to ban the transport of workers on the back of lorries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The long-term solution must be to ban the transport of workers on the back of lorries.

sections.label: Timeline for lorry transport ban
sections.summary: The first recommendation is to ban transporting workers on lorry backs, not overnight but with a timeline set for the ban.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My first recommendation is that we ban the transportation of workers on the back of lorries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I know I have repeated this many times in this speech.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But let me clarify that I am not calling for this to be done overnight but, instead, we should set a timeline for this ban.

sections.label: Pilot buses for construction workers
sections.summary: The Government should pilot using buses to transport workers for larger construction companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My second recommendation is that the Government pilot the use of buses to transport workers for the larger construction companies.

sections.label: Coordinate and fund worker bus transport
sections.summary: MOT and LTA could coordinate and provide funding with construction companies, dormitories and bus operators for bus transport of workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: MOT and LTA are well-placed to coordinate this and perhaps even consider providing some funding to make things happen.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I propose that the Government work with the larger construction companies, dormitories and bus operators to coordinate and provide some funding to help in the transportation of workers using buses.

sections.label: New lorry driver work limits
sections.summary: Under new requirements, lorry drivers cannot work more than 12 hours a day and must rest 30 minutes after six hours before driving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Under the new requirements, lorry drivers cannot work for more than 12 hours a day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Workers who have worked six hours must have at least 30 minutes rest immediately before driving.

sections.label: Reduce 12-hour driving limit
sections.summary: As an interim measure, the limit of 12 hours of working before driving could at least be reduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Lastly, as an interim measure of this interim measure, can we at least reduce the limit of 12 hours of working before driving?

sections.label: Ban transporting workers on lorries
sections.summary: Employers, supervisors and workers should take workplace safety seriously, and workers should not be transported on the back of lorries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I call on everyone involved – employers, supervisors and workers – to take safety at the workplace seriously." He said, "Lives are at stake.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have the responsibility to keep all our workers safe, whether they are local or foreign." I hope that we can heed Prime Minister Lee's call, take this safety issue seriously and put this right by banning the transport of workers on the back of lorries.

sections.label: Trade-offs are lives and injuries
sections.summary: The real trade-offs to focus on are people's lives and injuries that could disable a person for life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Indeed, the real trade-offs that we should be focusing on here are people's lives and the injuries that could disable a person for life.

sections.label: Lorry worker safety measures timeline
sections.summary: New measures include an advisory, dual-role driver rest, vehicle buddies, and rain covers for lorries on staggered dates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: These new measures have been rolled out progressively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We released the Inter-agency Advisory on Safe Transportation of Workers on 31 December 2022, which provides practical guidance to employers and workers on the new and existing legal requirements and recommends practices to enhance safety of workers on lorry transportation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The requirement for dual-role drivers to have sufficient rest and the appointment of a designated "vehicle buddy" as well as for all newly-registered lorries used to ferry workers to be installed with rain covers came into force on 1 January this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The requirement for in-use light lorries used to ferry workers to install rain covers just came into effect on 1 July 2023 and will come into effect for heavy lorries on 1 January 2024.

sections.label: Lorry accident fatalities and injuries decline
sections.summary: Average fatalities fell from around six (2013-2017) to around three (2018-2022), and injuries dropped by one-third.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The average number of fatalities from road traffic accidents involving persons onboard lorries has declined, from around six from 2013 to 2017, to around three from 2018 to 2022, even as we recognise that one fatality is one too many.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The average number of injuries has also dropped by one-third, from 522 from 2013 to 2017, to 359 from 2018 to 2022.

sections.label: Driver alertness measures and working hours
sections.summary: MOM measures give dual-role drivers 30 minutes' rest and a vehicle buddy; the 12-hour daily limit includes driving time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The recent Ministry of Manpower (MOM) measures of at least 30 minutes' rest immediately before driving for dual-role drivers who have worked six hours, and designated a vehicle buddy is intended to address the concern of driver alertness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: I do want to assure the Member, however, that the 12-hour daily limit of working hours includes the time spent driving, as that is considered part of work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: As I explained earlier, at its core, the challenges are not necessarily financial in nature and, if so, funding would not be an effective remedy.

sections.label: Examples of transport companies
sections.summary: Besides Tong Tar Transport Services, examples include Bedok Transport, Hui Leong Transport Service and JK59 Transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Besides Tong Tar Transport Services, which I had previously mentioned, other examples include Bedok Transport, Hui Leong Transport Service and JK59 Transport Pte Ltd.

sections.label: Request for roadmap to ban
sections.summary: A Member asks MOT to look into a roadmap towards banning transportation of workers on the back of lorries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: I hope it does not take that long to the ban.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: But could MOT just look into a roadmap towards a ban on the transportation of workers on the back of lorries?

sections.label: Further lorry safety measures review
sections.summary: Review will take time across sectors; some measures implemented, one ongoing, and safety belts on lorries are being considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It will take time because we are looking at various sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will share further when we are ready on this transit.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Some have been implemented and another one is ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will have to review this, but our foot is still on the pedal and we are still looking at further measures to enhance safety for our workers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, we were talking about whether we can install safety belts on the back of lorries.
